Sam (AE): FYI AcmeCare auditor asked for a single POC packet: 1) SOC2/ISO in-scope asset list, 2) network/data-flow diagram showing PHI touchpoints, 3) signed pen-test attestation (who signs + ETA), 4) cert/KMS proof for Private, and 5) cost delta for reserved staging. Needed by Fri EOD.

Ivy (Presales): I can deliver diagram + CSV manifest mapping services->CMDB IDs->CIDRs. Question: prefer hostnames or CMDB IDs? Auditor wants traceability to our inventory.

Tom (Security): Provide CMDB IDs and roles, not internal hostnames. Security can sign the operational attestation using our template; Legal must approve any custom wording. Signed letter ~3 business days after final pen-test report. If they want the vendors full report, we require NDA + vendor consent (+2 days).

Lena (Pricing): Reserved staging adds a tenancy premium (~+30% on A100 class). Ephemeral burst for 2-week POC is cheaper. I can draft a short cost comparison if you confirm expected vGPU count and peak QPS.

Sam (AE): Certs: AcmeCare wants CN+issuer for on-prem and proof keys are in customer KMS for Private.

Tom (Security): We can supply CN + issuer + redacted thumbprint. Never share private keys. For KMS, we provide key metadata and rotation runbook (redact customer IDs; Legal sign-off if screenshots included).

Upload Bot: Uploaded pen-test-attestation-template.pdf to https://drive.redwood.example/poc/4367890123 (owner: Tom)

Ivy (Presales): I'll upload PNG + draw.io XML and the CSV manifest by EOD. Tom will attach the attestation draft tomorrow. Lena will post cost delta later today.

Sam (AE): Action list: Ivy -> diagram + manifest (EOD). Tom -> attestation draft & cert/KMS one-pager (tomorrow). Lena -> cost delta (EOD). I'll assemble and send to AcmeCare auditor first thing Mon AM if all good. If they request vendor full report earlier we need NDA + vendor approval which may delay delivery.

Tom (Security): Note: vendor often redacts exploit details in full reports; expect summary-level findings.
